exclusions.name: obr.universal_credit_in_cap
exclusions.reason: The OBR welfare-cap boundary (UC in-cap vs outside-cap) is not measurable on the frame: the model cannot attribute UC spend to the cap concept, so the pair splits one well-measured total into two mis-attributed halves (-96.8% / +286.3% on the rebind packet while total UC spend is within band of the OBR anchor).

exclusions.name: ons.household_composition.lone_parent_non_dependent_children_households
